Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''Zygerrian''' was working as a enslaver in the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Labor Processing Hub]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].

==Biography==
This [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] worked in the Labor Processing Hub during the time when [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] were imprisoned there. He was seen whipping a Togruta enslaved individual with a [[Shock whip]] when the Togruta wanted to rest.
